verdict.rationale: Nix provides reproducible, project-scoped environments via `nix-shell` and `nix develop`, which set the right tool versions and environment variables for a project, but these require manually running a command inside the directory rather than automatically activating on `cd`. Automatic directory-based activation (e.g., via direnv integration) is not mentioned anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic activation on directory entry (direnv/nix-direnv integration), independent confirmation of seamless auto-activation UX.
